name: Green Impact Partners
summary: Green Impact Partners Inc. functions as a clean energy enterprise, delivering extensive water, waste, and solid material treatment and recycling solutions across North America. The company's business is structured into two core divisions: Water and Industrial, and Energy Production. Within its Water and Industrial segment, it operates seven specialized facilities dedicated to processing and reclaiming water and solid waste. Furthermore, the Energy Production division is deeply engaged in the entire lifecycle of renewable natural gas (RNG) projects, encompassing their acquisition, development, construction, and ongoing management. This segment also handles the supply of RNG, biofuels, and hydrogen. Green Impact Partners Inc. serves a broad spectrum of clients in sectors such as agriculture, forestry, governmental organizations, midstream operations, public infrastructure, oil and gas production, potash mining, and various utilities. The company's corporate headquarters are situated in Vancouver, Canada.
